name: foundry
description: Guides agents from GitHub issues to shipped code through gated, multi-perspective review loops.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.description: Comma-separated review perspectives. Every one must approve before a gate goes to you.

maxRounds.title: Round limit per stage
maxRounds.description: Review rounds allowed in a stage before it escalates to you. CI reruns for flaky tests don't count.

onlineReviewers.title: Online reviewers
onlineReviewers.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins of the automated reviewers that must review a pull request's head commit before it ships. They are on the allowlist: only their comments and the maintainers' reach the agent. A repository's foundry.yaml overrides this. Codecov belongs in CI, as its status check.

maintainers.title: Maintainers
maintainers.description: Comma-separated GitHub logins whose pull request comments count as reviewer feedback (never as sign-off). Empty means the account gh is signed in as. A repository's foundry.yaml overrides this.

botTimeoutMinutes.title: Online reviewer timeout (minutes)
botTimeoutMinutes.description: How long to wait for an online reviewer to review a new commit before it escalates to you.
